service.method: SELECT * FROM (SELECT snote.NOTICE_NUMBER ,snote.SUBJECT ,snote.COMPANY_CODE ,scmgl.COMPANY_NAME_LOC COMPANY_NAME ,snote.DEPT_TYPE ,snote.ATTACH_NO ,snote.ADD_USER_ID ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = SNOTE.HOUSE_CODE AND USER_ID = SNOTE.ADD_USER_ID) ADD_USER_NAME ,snote.ADD_DATE ,snote.ADD_TIME ,snote.CHANGE_USER_ID ,snote.CHANGE_DATE ,snote.CHANGE_TIME ,snote.DEL_FLAG ,snote.NOTE_TYPE ,snote.GONGJI_GUBUN ,GETCODETEXT(snote.HOUSE_CODE,'AD011', snote.GONGJI_GUBUN, 'KO') GONGJI_GUBUN_TEXT ,snote.PUBLISH_FLAG ,GETCODETEXT(snote.HOUSE_CODE,'AD013', snote.PUBLISH_FLAG, 'KO') PUBLISH_FLAG_TEXT ,snote.PUBLISH_FROM_DATE ,snote.PUBLISH_TO_DATE ,snote.VIEW_COUNT ,snote.POPUP_LOCATION FROM SNOTE snote INNER JOIN SCMGL scmgl ON scmgl.COMPANY_CODE = snote.COMPANY_CODE AND scmgl.HOUSE_CODE = snote.HOUSE_CODE WHERE NVL(snote.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND snote.NOTE_TYPE = 'N' AND snote.NOTICE_NUMBER = $S{NOTICE_NUMBER} AND snote.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND snote.COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE} ) A WHERE ( GONGJI_GUBUN_TEXT = $S{F_KEYWORD} OR PUBLISH_FLAG_TEXT = $S{F_KEYWORD} OR ADD_USER_NAME like $S{F_KEYWORD} OR NOTICE_NUMBER like $S{F_KEYWORD} OR SUBJECT like $S{F_KEYWORD} AND 1=1 ) AND ( (PUBLISH_FROM_DATE >= $S{F_DATE_FROM} AND PUBLISH_FROM_DATE <= $S{F_DATE_TO}) OR (PUBLISH_TO_DATE >= $S{F_DATE_FROM} AND PUBLISH_TO_DATE <= $S{F_DATE_TO}) AND 1=1 ) AND( COMPANY_CODE IN($INS{AFFILIATED_COMPANY})AND 1 = 1 ) ORDER BY NOTICE_NUMBER DESC

SELECT * FROM (SELECT NOTICE_NUMBER ,SUBJECT ,COMPANY_CODE ,DEPT_TYPE ,ATTACH_NO ,ADD_USER_ID ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = SNOTE.HOUSE_CODE AND USER_ID = SNOTE.ADD_USER_ID) ADD_USER_NAME ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,DEL_FLAG ,NOTE_TYPE ,GONGJI_GUBUN ,GETCODETEXT(HOUSE_CODE,'AD011', GONGJI_GUBUN, 'KO') GONGJI_GUBUN_TEXT ,snote.PUBLISH_FLAG ,GETCODETEXT(HOUSE_CODE,'AD013', PUBLISH_FLAG, 'KO') PUBLISH_FLAG_TEXT ,PUBLISH_FROM_DATE ,PUBLISH_TO_DATE ,VIEW_COUNT ,POPUP_LOCATION FROM SNOTE WHERE NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND NOTE_TYPE = 'N' AND NOTICE_NUMBER = $S{NOTICE_NUMBER} AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE} ) A WHERE ( GONGJI_GUBUN_TEXT = $S{F_KEYWORD} OR PUBLISH_FLAG_TEXT = $S{F_KEYWORD} OR ADD_USER_NAME like $S{F_KEYWORD} OR NOTICE_NUMBER like $S{F_KEYWORD} OR SUBJECT like $S{F_KEYWORD} AND 1=1 ) AND ( (PUBLISH_FROM_DATE >= $S{F_DATE_FROM} AND PUBLISH_FROM_DATE <= $S{F_DATE_TO}) OR (PUBLISH_TO_DATE >= $S{F_DATE_FROM} AND PUBLISH_TO_DATE <= $S{F_DATE_TO}) AND 1=1 ) AND( COMPANY_CODE IN($INS{AFFILIATED_COMPANY})AND 1 = 1 ) ORDER BY NOTICE_NUMBER DESC
SELECT NOTICE_SEQ ,CONTENT FROM SNOTD WHERE NOTICE_NUMBER = ${NOTICE_NUMBER} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY CAST( NOTICE_SEQ AS NUMBER )

SELECT COMPANY_NAME_LOC FROM SCMGL scmgl INNER JOIN SNOTE snote ON scmgl.COMPANY_CODE = snote.COMPANY_CODE AND scmgl.HOUSE_CODE = snote.HOUSE_CODE WHERE snote.NOTICE_NUMBER =${NOTICE_NUMBER} AND SNOTE.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}

UPDATE SNOTE SET SUBJECT = ${SUBJECT} ,COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} ,DEPT_TYPE = ${DEPT_TYPE} ,ATTACH_NO = ${ATTACH_NO} ,CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} ,CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE} ,CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME} ,DEL_FLAG = 'N' ,NOTE_TYPE = ${NOTE_TYPE} ,GONGJI_GUBUN = ${GONGJI_GUBUN} ,PUBLISH_FLAG = ${PUBLISH_FLAG} ,PUBLISH_FROM_DATE = ${PUBLISH_FROM_DATE} ,PUBLISH_TO_DATE = ${PUBLISH_TO_DATE} ,VIEW_COUNT = 0 ,POPUP_LOCATION = ${POPUP_LOCATION} WHERE NOTICE_NUMBER = ${NOTICE_NUMBER} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE}

SELECT NOTICE_NUMBER , SUBJECT FROM SNOTE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND POPUP_LOCATION = $S{POPUP_LOCATION} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND PUBLISH_FLAG = 'Y' AND GONGJI_GUBUN in ( $S{session.USER_TYPE}, 'A') AND ( PUBLISH_FROM_DATE <= ${current.DATE} AND PUBLISH_TO_DATE >= ${current.DATE} AND 1=1 ) ORDER BY NOTICE_NUMBER DESC
